technique_name: Rewrite the following passage in a less technical manner.
description: The Monte Carlo method is a way of solving problems with many variables by using random sampling. Instead of relying on equations, it uses a series of trial and error steps to get numerical results.
example:
Passage:
The Monte Carlo method is a computational algorithm that utilizes random sampling to obtain numerical results. It is often used for estimating real-world problems with multiple variables.
